Name: Pharez
Summary: Pharez was the twin son of Judah and Tamar, born after his brother Zerah, and the ancestor of David's line.
KeyStory: Pharez broke out first at birth despite Zerah's hand appearing first — and through Pharez the promise line ran to David and to Christ.
RelatedPeople: Judah; Tamar; Zerah, Son of Judah; Hezron, Son of Pharez; Hamul
LifeLesson: God's choice breaks through human order: the line to David ran through Pharez.
